MOONSCREEDPORT-LOST_TECHNOLOGY.title: Lost Technology
MOONSCREEDPORT-LOST_TECHNOLOGY.pages.INI:
During your journey, you come across a ruined altar deep within an ancient chamber. At the center of the altar lies a piece that seems to have broken off from your landing pod. Despite the passage of time, its surface still shimmers faintly with light.

As you approach, the symbols on the piece suddenly glow, and a holographic message appears before you:
[aqua]Each upgrade may strain system resources. Choose wisely.[/aqua]
MOONSCREEDPORT-LOST_TECHNOLOGY.pages.GUN: The pod initiates a recalibration of its targeting matrices.
MOONSCREEDPORT-LOST_TECHNOLOGY.pages.MIS: The pod augments your missile capabilities.
MOONSCREEDPORT-LOST_TECHNOLOGY.pages.INI: Add [blue]{Cards}[/blue] random Regent cards to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
MOONSCREEDPORT-LOST_TECHNOLOGY.pages.LEA: You turn away from the pod, resuming your journey. Behind you, the abandoned technology pulses with fading blue light before falling permanently silent.
MOONSCREEDPORT-SONG_OF_THE_ORACLES.title: Song of the Reaps
MOONSCREEDPORT-SONG_OF_THE_ORACLES.pages: As you journey onward, you enter a room and notice an intriguing altar. The altar bears strange symbols and radiates pulsating energy. On its surface, two scythes appear: one glowing white with serenity, the other shrouded in shadows. Whispers fill your mind: [blue][sine]Which path will you choose?[/sine][/blue]
The light reap connects with you, shining with radiance. You feel a protective energy, but notice that your power feels limited.
Your Max HP is too low.
The dark reap connects with you, surrounded by shadows. You feel unlimited power, but begin to bear the weight of an uncontrollable energy.
You feel both peace and destruction within you, but maintaining this balance requires great effort.
MOONSCREEDPORT-THE_LAST_KNIGHTS_WILL.pag:
You come across an altar surrounded by the remnants of an armor worn down by time. The symbols engraved on its chestplate bear the traces of an ancient legend. As you begin to read the text on the altar, a voice echoes:

[blue]Once, I gave everything to protect these lands. Now, I offer this power to you. But know this, such power comes only with [sine]great sacrifices.[/sine][/blue]
The symbols on the armor begin to glow, and their energy flows into your body. You are now a part of this legend.
Add [blue]{Cards}[/blue] random Ironclad Attacks to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
You quietly pass by the altar and move on.
